fit_reason: Whole 2012 Ford Edge SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dusty dashboard top with visible debris across the front dash

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2012 Ford Edge. From the photos the dash top is pretty dusty and the headlights look a bit hazy, both things that show up in listing pictures. We do mobile pre-sale details, including interior cleaning, leather conditioning and headlight restoration, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
